title: Development page stayed at initial loading state until server restart
steps: Open a client-component page on an existing App Router development server.
Reload in fresh browser contexts and inspect static script responses, hydration and browser requests.
Restart the development server without changing frontend source and reload.
observed: One UI test remained at the initial loading state and timed out after 120 seconds.
Fresh loads received static scripts with HTTP 200 but made no session API requests.
The development WebSocket handshake failed with an invalid HTTP response.
expected: Client components should initialise and issue their requests after static scripts load, or show an actionable error.
comparison: Restarting the development server restored client startup; browser workflows also passed with a local production build.
